name: c64-re-tools
description: The c64-re-tools toolkit in the project and the native tools of its skills: ACME, dxa, Exomizer and c64run (the C64 replay core, with the C64 ROMs); sjasmplus and zxrun (the ZX Spectrum replay core, with the ZX Spectrum ROMs). At image build and at each start it installs the toolkit version of the channel and the tools of that version. The Host Runtime with VICE and ZEsarUX runs on the graphical host.

target.description: The harnesses to install the toolkit for, one name or a comma list, for example claude,codex.

machines.description: The machines to install an MCP server for: c64, spectrum, or a comma list. A change takes effect when the container is built again.

channel.description: The npm channel of the toolkit: latest for the release, next for the newest prerelease or release. The container gets the newest version of the channel and its tools at each start, not the version of this Feature.
